<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 6.2pt; text-indent: 57.3pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">1.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>EMPLOYMENT
AND DUTIES.</U> Company and Solar employ Executive as its President and Chief Executive Officer. Executive shall report only to the
Board of Directors of Company and Solar, as the case may <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">be. </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Pr</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -1.55pt">e</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">siden</FONT>t <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.15pt">s</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">h</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">a</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">l</FONT>l <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.55pt">b</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">r</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">espons</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -2.35pt">i</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.9pt">b</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">l</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.8pt">f</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.75pt">p</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">ro</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.35pt">v</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">i</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -1.35pt">d</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">i</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.55pt">n</FONT>g <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">str</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.95pt">a</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">t</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.8pt">e</FONT>g<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.95pt">i</FONT>c <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">leadersh</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -4.75pt">i</FONT>p <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">for </FONT>Company
and Solar by working with their respective Boards <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.25pt">of</FONT> Directors and other management to
establish long-range goals, strategies, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">plans, </FONT>and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">policies. </FONT>The
following conditions shall apply to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>employment under this <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Agreement: </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">(i)</FONT>
Executive shall be permitted to work from home at his <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">discretion; </FONT>(ii) Executive shall
be the Company and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT>only President and Chief Executive Officer and no other
individual shall hold the position of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">President, </FONT>Chief Executive Officer or co-President
or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">co-Chief </FONT>Executive Officer; (iii) other than the Board of Directors, no individual
or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">individuals, </FONT>whether acting as a committee or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">otherwise, </FONT>shall
have <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">executive</FONT> authority over or equal to that of the Executive and neither the Company
nor Solar shall take any action which would or could have the effect of giving any individual(s) such authority or which appears to
give any individual(s) such authority; (iv) <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive&rsquo;s</FONT> title may not be changed
or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">modified </FONT>in any way; (v) <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>duties
shall not be changed in any way from those he has performed <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">previously, </FONT>nor shall <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive&rsquo; </FONT>s
duties or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">responsibilities </FONT>be reduced in any way; (vi) Executive shall devote sufficient
time to the performance <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.1pt">of</FONT> his duties as <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">President, </FONT>Chief
Executive Officer of both Company and Solar; <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">(viii) </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive </FONT>shall
be entitled to the full protection of all applicable indemnification provisions of the Company and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT>Articles
of Incorporation and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.55pt">bylaws, </FONT>for his service as a <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">director,</FONT>
executive officer and employee of the Company and Solar.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.8pt 0 5.9pt; text-indent: 0.05pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 6.2pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 57.3pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">If:
</FONT>(i) Company or Solar changes the Executive&rsquo;s duties and responsibilities as those duties are set forth in this Section 1
without Executive&rsquo;s consent (including, without limitation, violation of any of the provisions of clauses (ii)-(v) above; (ii) there
occurs a breach by Company or Solar of any of their obligations under this Agreement that has not been cured in all material respects
within ten (10) days after the Executive gives notice thereof to the Company or Solar, as <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">the </FONT>case
may <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">be;</FONT> (iii) there occurs a &ldquo;change in <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">control&rdquo;</FONT>
(as that term is defined below) with respect to either Company or Solar or; (iv) the Executive has not been paid for a cumulative sixty
(60) day period without <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive&rsquo;s</FONT> <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">consent,
</FONT>then Executive <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">shall</FONT> have the right to terminate his employment with Company and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Solar,
</FONT>but such termination shall not be considered a voluntary resignation or termination of such employment or of this Employment Agreement
by the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Executive</FONT> but rather a discharge of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive</FONT>
by the Company and Solar &ldquo;without cause&rdquo; (as that term is defined <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">below). </FONT>For
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">purposes</FONT> of this Agreement, the term &ldquo;change in control&rdquo; means the first to occur
of the following events:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.9pt 0 7.35pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 7.35pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 35.9pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(i)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>any
person or group of commonly controlled persons acquires , directly or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">indirectly,</FONT> fifty percent
(50%) or more of the voting control or value of the equity interests in the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Solar;</FONT>
or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.7pt 0 7.35pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 35.9pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8.6pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 35pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(ii)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>the
shareholders of Company or Solar approving an <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">agreement</FONT> to merge or consolidate with
another corporation or other entity resulting (whether separately or in connection with a series of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">transactions) </FONT>in
a change in ownership of fifty percent (50%) or more of the voting control or value of the equity interests in Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Solar, </FONT>or
an agreement to sell or otherwise dispose of all or substantially all of Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT>assets
(including, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">without </FONT>limitation, a plan of liquidation or dissolutio<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.7pt">n</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -6.95pt">,</FONT>) <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">otherwis</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">approv</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>f
a <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">fundamenta</FONT>l <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">alteratio</FONT>n <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">i</FONT>n <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">the </FONT>nature
of the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.7pt">Solar&rsquo; </FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">business.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 5.75pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.65pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.7pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(i)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Executive&rsquo;</FONT>
s commission of willful and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">intentional</FONT> acts involving gross misconduct (including, without
limitation, theft, fraud or embezzlement) ;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 11.15pt 0 11.35pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.7pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.65pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.7pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(ii)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Executive&rsquo;s

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.65pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.7pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(iii)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>a

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.95pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Withou</U></FONT><U>t
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Caus</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.65pt">e</FONT></U>. <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Executiv</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -4.65pt">e</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.9pt">&rsquo;</FONT>s

</FONT>Control (as <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">defined</FONT> in Section 1 above), Executive may <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">elect,</FONT>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 62pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">6.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>SEVERANCE.
- TERMINATION RESULTING FROM DEATH, DISABILITY OR FOR CAUSE</U>. In the event <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>employment <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">under </FONT>this
Agreement is terminated in <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">connection </FONT>with <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive&rsquo;s</FONT>
death or long-term disability or by Company for Cause, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Company </FONT>shall pay Executive (or
in the case of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">death, </FONT>his heirs or personal representatives), within thirty (30) days
after the effective date of termination, Executive&rsquo;s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Annual </FONT>Base Compensation and
benefits and all expenses payable under Section 4 above through such date of death or termination, and Company shall have no further
obligation to provide compensation or benefits to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive</FONT> under this <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Agreement; </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">provided,</FONT>
however, that to the extent that any of Company&rsquo;s benefit plans provide rights or benefits after termination, Executive may
continue to receive such rights or benefits in accordance with the terms of such plans.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 62pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">7.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><U>SEVERANCE
-TERMINATION WITHOUT CAUSE</U>. In the event Executive&rsquo;s employment under this Agreement is terminated for any reason other
than as a result of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">death, </FONT>long-term disability or for Cause by Company, such
termination shall be a termination without cause for all purposes of this Agreement and the entire balance of the Executive&rsquo;s
Annual Base Compensation due for the remainder of the Initial Term (or any subsequent annual terms if the termination occurs after
the expiration of the Initial Term) shall become immediately due and payable to Executive. In <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">addition, </FONT>Company
shall continue to pay one hundred percent (100%) of the premiums for health and other insurance coverage for the Executive as was in
effect as of the effective date of termination such payments to continue for eighteen (18) months after the effective date of
termination. Within thirty (30) days after the date of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">termination,</FONT> the Company shall
reimburse Executive for all expenses payable under Section 4(c) above through such date of termination. <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Furthermore, </FONT>to
the extent that any of Compan<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -3.55pt">y</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.5pt">&rsquo;</FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">benefi</FONT>t <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">plan</FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">provid</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">right</FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">benefit</FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">afte</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">a</FONT>n <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">employe</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -4pt">e</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.5pt">&rsquo;</FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">termination,</FONT>
Executive shall continue to receive such rights or benefits in accordance with the terms of such plans.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 8.5pt 0 6.75pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.05pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 62pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">8.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>STOCK
OPTIONS</U>. Upon (i) the dissolution or liquidation of Company or Solar; (ii) a termination of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;s</FONT>
employment other than by the Company for <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Cause;</FONT> (iii) any merger or consolidation in which
the Company or Solar is not the surviving corporation; or (iv) a Change in <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Control,</FONT> all stock
options awarded to the Executive under any stock option plans shall immediately become one hundred percent (100%) vested and fully exercisable
by Executive (or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;s</FONT> <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">heirs,</FONT> as the
case may be) no later than the date immediately preceding the effective date of such <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">dissolution,
</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">terminatio</FONT>n <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>f <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">empl</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -1.65pt">o</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">ymen</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">t</FONT>,
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">merge</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">consolidatio</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -4.4pt">n</FONT>,
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Chang</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>f
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Control </FONT>and the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive</FONT> shall have the right
to exercise <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;</FONT> s stock options in whole or in part at any time within the next
four (4) <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">years.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 7.25pt 0 8.55pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 69.1pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 62pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">9.
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>NOTES AND WARRANTS - TERMINATION WITHOUT CAUSE.</U> In the event <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>employment
is terminated for any reason other than a termination by Company or Solar for <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Cause, </FONT>such
termination shall have no effect on any Notes or other obligations of Company or Solar held by <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">including, </FONT>without <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">limitation, </FONT>the
Warrant or any warrants subsequently issued by Company or Solar to Executive individually or to Executive and his spouse. Any such
notes or warrants shall continue in full force and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">effect, </FONT>subject only to the express
terms and conditions contained in any such notes or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.55pt">warrants.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.4pt 0 6.65pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.05pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 62pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">10.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>CONFIDENTIALITY </U>.
Executive recognizes and acknowledges that he will have access to certain confidential information of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Company, </FONT>Solar
and of entities <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.05pt">with </FONT>whom Company and Solar do <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">business, </FONT>and
that such information constitutes valuable, special and unique property of the Company and Solar and such other entities. During the
Term of this Agreement and for a period of two (2) years immediately following the date of termination of this <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Agreement, </FONT>Executive
agrees not to disclose or use any confidential information, including without limitation, information concerning the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT>financial
condition, research and development activities, technologies, product designs and/or specifications, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">&ldquo;know-how;&rdquo;</FONT>
prices, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">customers, </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">prospects,</FONT> methods of
doing <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">business, </FONT>marketing and promotional activities , or any information or knowledge
with respect to confidential information or trade secrets of the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Solar,</FONT> it
being understood that such confidential information does not include information that is publicly available unless such information
became publicly available as a result of a breach of this Agreement. Executive acknowledges and agrees that all <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">notes, </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">records, </FONT>reports,
sketches, plans, unpublished memoranda or other documents belonging to the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Solar,</FONT>
but held by Executive, concerning any information relating to the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT>business,
whether confidential or not, are the property of the Company and Solar and will be promptly delivered to it upon Executive&rsquo;s
leaving the employ of the Company and Solar. Executive also agrees to execute such confidentiality agreements that the Board of
Directors may adopt, and may modify from time to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">time,</FONT> as a standard form to be executed
by all executive employees of the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Solar, </FONT>to the extent such standard forms
are not more restrictive than the provisions of this <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Agreement.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 7.35pt 0 5.75pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.2pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 71.65pt">The restrictions
set forth in this Section are considered to be reasonable for the purposes of protecting the business of Company and Solar. <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Company,
</FONT>Solar and Executive acknowledge that Company and Solar would be irreparably harmed and that monetary damages would not provide
an adequate remedy to the Company if the covenants contained in this Section were not complied with in accordance with its terms. Accordingly,
Executive agrees that Company and Solar shall be entitled to injunctive and other equitable relief to secure the enforcement of these
provisions, in addition to any other remedy which may be available to the Company. Any legal action commenced by the Company or Solar
to secure the enforcement of this Section shall be commenced in Montgomery County, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Maryland. </FONT>The
prevailing party in any such legal action shall be <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">entitled</FONT> to receive from the other party
reimbursement for the reasonable attorneys&rsquo; fees and expenses incurred by the prevailing <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">party.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.9pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 71.65pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 7pt 0 12.45pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25pt">The provisions
of Section shall survive the termination of this Agreement, regardless of the circumstances or reasons for such termination, and inure
to the benefit of the Company.</P>

PROPERTY</U>. Executive acknowledges and agrees that all discoveries, inventions, designs, improvements, formulas, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">formulations, </FONT>ideas, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">devices, </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">writings,
publications, </FONT>study <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">protocols, </FONT>study results, computer data or programs, or other
intellectual property, whether or not subject to patent or copyright laws, which Executive shall conceive solely or jointly with
others, in the course or scope of his employment with the Company and Solar (collectively referred to herein as <U>&ldquo;Intellectual
Property&rdquo;) ,</U> shall be the sole and exclusive property of Company and Solar without further compensation to the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Executive. </FONT>Inventions,
if any, patented or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">unpatented,</FONT> which Executive made prior to the commencement of his
employment with Company and Solar are <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">excluded</FONT> from the scope of this Agreement.</P>

</FONT>Except as provided in the next <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">paragraph, </FONT>in the event that a dispute arises between
Executive and Company or Solar <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">concerning</FONT> any matter under this Agreement, such dispute shall
be resolved through binding arbitration <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">which </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">shall
</FONT>be conducted before three (3) impartial <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">arbitrators. </FONT>One arbitrator shall be selected
by each party and the two arbitrators who are so selected shall select the third arbitrator. Any such arbitration shall be held in Montgomery
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">County, </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Maryland. </FONT>The arbitrators <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">shall</FONT>
reach a decision in the arbitration based on the facts of the matter and applicable law. The <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Arbitrators</FONT>
decision shall be final and binding on the parties and enforceable in a court of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">law.</FONT> Company
and Solar shall pay all costs and fees in connection with the arbitration.</P>
